title: Unnamed Payments and the Quoted Balance on Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Accounts
content:
**Cash application rule.** This rule of Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility governs the order in which open charges are settled and the balance quoted to a patient.

**Oldest-first allocation.** A patient payment that names no charge is allocated across all of the patient's coverage accounts, oldest open charge first: open charges are taken in their open-charge order and each receives the smaller of its open amount and the payment still unallocated, one payment entry per charge, until the payment is used up. *Partly retired:* for an arrangement deposit, and only for an arrangement deposit, this clause is no longer in force; every other patient payment that names no charge remains under it as written.

## Clauses in force

- **Unreturned equipment last.** Charges for unreturned equipment are taken last, after every other open charge.
- **Secondary payments stay put.** A secondary payment is never reallocated: it settles only the charge it adjudicated.
- **Quoted balance.** The patient's total balance is the sum of the patient balance across all of their coverage accounts, and that total is what is quoted when the patient asks what they owe.

## Open charges and their order

For each patient charge, its open amount is the charge's amount less the patient payments, secondary payments and adjustments applied to that charge, counting every entry on every coverage account of the patient up to the handling date. A charge is open while that result is above 0.00. Open charges are ordered by posting date, and charges posted on the same date by the reference of their originating line.

## Example of the quoted balance (hypothetical)

| Coverage account | Patient balance |
|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B (primary) | 142.60 |
| Medicare Supplement Plan G (secondary) | 0.00 |
| Former Commercial PPO (terminated) | 35.00 |

The patient who asks what they owe is quoted 177.60 — the sum across all three accounts, the terminated account included.

## Points of judgement

- A Medicaid crossover payment that settled a coinsurance charge stays on that charge; it is never moved to another charge.
- An open unreturned-equipment charge posted earlier than every other open charge is still taken after them.
